title: lupinus glabratus
intro: Lupinus glabratus, commonly known as the slender lupine or small-flowered lupine, is a perennial flowering plant native to western North America. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to soothe respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus glabratus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also make it useful for treating conditions such as asthma, bronchitis, and menstrual cramps.
